claims.text: The source shows diffusion beating GANs via architecture scale (128 base channels, multi-resolution attention, BigGAN resblocks, AdaGN timestep+class conditioning) plus classifier guidance: noisy classifier p_phi(y|xt,t) steers ancestral/DDIM sampling with scale s trading precision vs recall.

Reported numbers: ImageNet-128 ADM-Guided FID 2.97 vs BigGAN 6.02; ImageNet-256 4.59 (25-step 5.44) vs BigGAN 6.95; 256 ADM-Guided+Upsampled 3.94, 512 3.85; LSUN-Bedroom 1.90/Horse 2.57/Cat 5.57 vs StyleGAN 2.35/3.84/7.25.

limitations.text: 250-step sampling (25-step viable) still slower than GANs; classifier + large-upsample compute heavy; FID/IS/precision/recall imperfect proxies.
